title: Relative SL2 determinant-one matrix presheaf
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. The relative special linear group presheaf $\mathrm{SL}_{2,S}$ on $S$-schemes sends $T\to S$ to the group of determinant-one $2\times2$ matrices over $\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$, with matrix multiplication. A morphism $T\to U$ acts by applying the pullback of global functions entrywise. The identity and composition laws are the entrywise ring-map identity and composition laws. Equivalently this is the composite of the opposite forgetful functor from $S$-schemes, global sections, and the determinant-one matrix group functor.
